note: Starting targets for 2.0. Report only: arc prints pass or fail per gate and always exits 0.

gates.text: passive player in the bottom half of the league at the end in at least 70 percent of careers
reckless goes bust in at least 20 percent of careers
expander finishes first in 40 to 70 percent of careers
first place changes hands at least 3 times a decade (median, a new leader must hold 13 weeks)
median traded good's (one with a gateway) yearly price range at least 15 percent of its own yearly mean price (what a player sees; world swings and the cycle count)
median local good's (services and retail goods, no gateway) yearly price range at least 8 percent of its own yearly mean price
no good's price reverses a material weekly move more than 10 times a year (market_health's limit)
the mean good's price reverses a material weekly move at most 2 times a year (market_health's limit)
a player ranked in the top three is the target of at least 2 hostile moves a decade (median)
rivals order at least 30 plants a decade (median)
the median surviving top-ten rival ends the decade with more blocks than it started
household demand for services and retail that goes without falls at least 5 points over the decade (median)
raids on the player are announced at least 4 weeks before they resolve (median; n/a until raid warnings exist)
at least one plant changes hands a decade for every ten companies (median, every route: auction, listing, direct sale)
a company is folded into its 90 percent owner in most careers
